column1: # QA-R4 category "english" (spec/04-quality-release.md): English words and tech terms that MUST restore
# unchanged, the QA-R4 hand list (QACorpus.englishHandList), typed in Telex with default options and
# committed at a boundary. Resources: the 13.9 fixtures with the hand list added to the English lexicon
# (option qa-english), so the rules of 8.1 that need a lexicon (L4, L6, L8, L10) apply to these words.
# Words that are also valid Vietnamese with an ambiguity row "vi" (this) restore only in an English run
# (ENG-R823, L10); their run rows start with an English token. The permissive word list of QA-R4 is the
# data track's English lexicon (ENG-T10); this file is the hand list.
# Columns: id, method, options, keys, expected (whole field), restore (- not checked), note.
# Keys: TSV escapes \s space, \n Return, \t Tab; markers ⌫ Backspace, ⎋ restore toggle, ⟲ reset.
